sources.snippet: miniLLAMA provides a compact implementation of LLAMA and LLAMA2, making it easier for enthusiasts and learners to grasp the nuances of these architectures. By drawing parallels with MiniGPT, it simplifies the understanding of LLAMA and facilitates experimentation.

sources.snippet: The proof was a 70-billion-parameter model trained on far more data that beat a 280-billion model — four times smaller, yet better, because it was actually trained enough.
